checks.title: Confirm role and purpose
checks.instructions: Read this Crew's saved identity and purpose. Confirm it is authorized to analyze finance records, even if its role also covers another installed template. Do not overwrite its identity merely to fit this pack.

checks.title: Verify the finance skill
checks.instructions: Confirm skills/finance-analyst/SKILL.md exists and finance-analyst is selected for this Crew. Complete only after both checks pass.

checks.title: Choose a data source
checks.instructions: Ask the owner for an uploaded statement or an authorized finance connection. Verify that the chosen data is readable. An uploaded file is sufficient; do not require an MCP connection.

checks.title: Set period and currency
checks.instructions: Agree on the reporting period and currency. Save stable preferences in MEMORY.md, and complete only after the owner confirms them.

checks.title: Define the numbers
checks.instructions: Agree on the measures used for revenue, cash received, refunds, and expenses. Keep invoiced, recognized, and collected amounts distinct. Save stable definitions in MEMORY.md.

checks.title: Test the first brief
checks.instructions: Produce a finance brief from authorized data with sources and calculations. Ask the owner to review it. Complete only after a brief was produced and the owner confirms it is useful.

checks.title: Decide where briefs go
checks.instructions: Ask whether briefs stay in Crew chat or go to an approved Slack or email destination. Choosing chat-only or not needed is a valid completed decision. Do not send anything without explicit authorization.

checks.title: Decide on recurring work
checks.instructions: Ask whether the owner wants a schedule or new-statement trigger. Choosing not needed is valid. If requested, agree on timezone or event source, test the result, and enable only with authorization.

checks.title: Decide on reusable access
checks.instructions: Ask whether other Crews need an analyze_finances function or whether a separate goal-based Automation is useful. Choosing neither is valid. Review permissions and the contract before exposing either.
